She stares instead at the sealed aperture—the Entity is now an integrated part of the station’s architecture. "It knows its weakness," she states flatly, her voice dangerously controlled amidst the noise. "It's not just assimilating; it's learning how to exploit our own structure."

Helena steps forward from the console, her eyes flicking between you (and the clamps in your hand) and the horrific data stream. She points to the schematic—the Entity's newest integration point is directly adjacent to Sector Two’s failing bulkheads.
